new.title: Eat seafood at Secret Garden Restaurant on Büyükada
new.desc: Secret Garden Restaurant is a fish restaurant on Büyükada ranked first on a Wanderlog list of the island's restaurants; reviewers cite fresh seafood and friendly staff.
new.tip: Take the ferry early and reserve in summer.
new.q: Secret Garden Restaurant, Büyükada, Adalar, İstanbul

new.title: Dine on seafood with views at Ali Baba Restaurant, Büyükada
new.desc: Time Out lists Ali Baba Restaurant on Büyükada as a place to eat seafood while taking in the island views.
new.tip: Time a visit with sunset and confirm hours.
new.q: Ali Baba Restaurant, Büyükada, Adalar, İstanbul

new.title: Eat fresh fish at İskandil Restaurant in Şile
new.desc: İskandil Restaurant is among the highly rated seafood restaurants in Şile on Restaurantguru; reviewers call it a top fish restaurant.
new.tip: Go in daylight for sea views; check opening times in winter.

new.title: Eat mantı at Şinanay Mantı in İzmit
new.desc: Şinanay Mantı is listed on Yemek.com's guide to İzmit venues at Karabaş, Şht. Musa Sokak 13/A.
new.tip: Order the mantı with yogurt; check hours.
new.q: Şinanay Mantı, Şht. Musa Sokak 13/A, Karabaş, İzmit, Kocaeli

new.title: Try Kırklareli köfte at Birtat Köftecisi
new.desc: Birtat Köftecisi in central Kırklareli serves the geographically indicated Kırklareli köfte, made with 100 percent veal rib meat.
new.tip: Order the köfte with bread and salad.

new.title: Eat köfte at Ayan Kardeşler Köfte Salonu, Kırklareli
new.desc: Ayan Kardeşler Köfte Salonu is named among the old, locally preferred köfte places in Kırklareli city centre.
new.tip: Go at lunch; try the Kırklareli köfte.
new.q: Ayan Kardeşler Köfte Salonu, Kırklareli Merkez, Kırklareli
